title: Real form of the estimator output
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. Given three lists of $m$ cube inputs, the rational restricted Fourier weight estimator output, viewed as a real number, equals the sum of the corresponding real restricted Fourier weight observations divided by $m$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
